status: Persistent two single-bit flash data differences exactly account for full-image SHA256 mismatch
verification: Three whole-image reads produced identical SHA256; 37 CRC32 windows inspected; differing zero windows bisected to sectors, both sectors reread to different RAM addresses; modifying only these two expected zero bytes offline reproduces observed SHA256 exactly.
cause: Not yet established. FES verification has an additional transient discrepancy of 0x8000. No claim that flash is verified or DDR fully qualified.
